parameters.question: WGCNA module-trait table: each module eigengene's Pearson correlation with Disease and its p-value. Module color labels, row order, column order and headers may differ, so match modules by their correlation values, not by label. If both files have the same number of modules, Correlation and Pvalue must match within +/-0.05. If module counts differ, take the top-N modules by absolute correlation (N = the smaller module count); the Spearman rank correlation between the two rankings must be >= 0.6, and the module with the highest |correlation| must have the same sign in both files.
